gloss: to give a ride, to put on

definitions.gloss: to give a ride, to let ride
definitions.explanation: To allow someone to board a vehicle.

definitions.gloss: to put on, to place on
definitions.explanation: To set something on a surface.

examples.japanese: {テーブル|てーぶる}に{乗|の}せる。

examples.english: I was tricked by their words.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}を{車|くるま}に{乗|の}せた。
examples.english: I gave my friend a ride in my car.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{棚|たな}に{乗|の}せた。
examples.english: I put the luggage on the shelf.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{自転車|じてんしゃ}に{乗|の}せる。
examples.english: To put a child on a bicycle.

examples.japanese: お{皿|さら}に{料理|りょうり}を{乗|の}せる。
examples.english: To place the food on a plate.

examples.japanese: タクシーに{乗|の}せてください。
examples.english: Please give me a ride in the taxi.
To place on the palm of the hand.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}まで{乗|の}せてもらった。
examples.english: I got a ride to the station.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY PAIR:
- {乗|の}せる (transitive): to put (someone/something) on, to give a ride
- {乗|の}る (intransitive): to ride, to get on

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {乗|の}せる: to give a ride, to put on (vehicles, surfaces)
- {載|の}せる: to load, to publish, to post (cargo, articles)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {車|くるま}に{乗|の}せる: to give someone a ride
- {口|くち}に{乗|の}せる/{乗|の}せられる: to be talked into, to be tricked
- {調子|ちょうし}に{乗|の}せる: to encourage (sometimes to excess)
- {軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}せる: to put on track, to get going
